message.content:
Based on the screenshot of **buskool.com**, here is a detailed visual design analysis:

## 1. Visual Design & Color Palette

**Primary Brand Colors:**
- **Primary Orange:** `#FF9F2A` (used for CTA buttons, search icon, accents)
- **Primary Orange Hover/Darker:** `#F5910B`
- **Dark Text/Headers:** `#1A1A1A` or `#222222`
- **Body Text Gray:** `#666666` or `#4A4A4A`
- **Light Gray Backgrounds:** `#F5F5F5` or `#FAFAFA` (section backgrounds)
- **White:** `#FFFFFF` (cards, header background)
- **Border/Divider Gray:** `#E5E5E5` or `#EEEEEE`

**Accent Colors:**
- **Success Green (for "باسکول" badge):** `#10B981` or `#059669`
- **Link Blue:** `#2563EB` (for hyperlinks in footer)

## 2. Layout Structure (Top to Bottom)

**A. Top Notification Bar:**
- Full-width, very light pink/beige background (`#FFF5F5` or `#FEF2F2`)
- Centered Persian text about the platform
- Height: ~40px
- Font size: ~12-13px

**B. Main Header (Sticky/Fixed):**
- White background with subtle bottom shadow (`box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)`)
- **Left side:** Logo ("buskool" with distinctive orange 'o' or accent), hamburger menu icon
- **Center:** Search bar with orange search button on left (RTL layout), placeholder text in gray
- **Right side:** Three icon+text items (Register/Login, Categories, etc.) with icons in dark gray
- Height: ~70-80px
- Padding: ~20px horizontal

**C. Hero Section:**
- Full-width background image (warehouse/logistics photo) with dark overlay (`rgba(0,0,0,0.5)` or `rgba(0,0,0,0.6)`)
- Content aligned to right (RTL)
- White text with high contrast
- Height: ~350-400px
- CTA button: Bright orange with white text, rounded corners (~8px radius), slight shadow

**D. Category Grid Section:**
- White background
- Title centered: "دسته بندی های اصلی"
- **Grid:** 5 columns on desktop, responsive
- **Category Cards:** Circular image containers (perfect circles, `border-radius: 50%`) with soft shadows
- Each card has: Image circle (~100-120px diameter) + Persian label below
- Background colors of circles vary subtly (beige, light blue, light pink tints)
- Gap between cards: ~30-40px
- Padding section: ~60px vertical

**E. Product Listing Sections (Skeleton/Placeholder):**
- Light gray background sections (`#F9FAFB`)
- Card grids showing loading states (gray rectangles with rounded corners ~12px radius)
- 5-column grid layout
- Cards have: Image placeholder (aspect ratio ~4:3), title line, price line, location line
- Subtle border: `1px solid #E5E7EB`

**F. Buy Request Form Section (درخواست خرید):**
- Light gray background (`#F3F4F6`)
- Two-column layout (form left, info right in RTL = form on right visually):
  - **Right side (Form):** White card with rounded corners (~16px radius), shadow (`box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)`)
    - Fields: Product name (text input), Category (dropdown with orange text highlight), Quantity inputs (two inline inputs for min/max), Description (textarea)
    - Submit button: Full-width orange (`#FF9F2A`), height ~48px, rounded (~8px), white bold text
    - Required fields marked with red asterisk (*)
  - **Left side (Info):** 
    - Heading + descriptive text
    - Feature list with icons (orange colored icons):
      - "ثبت نام در سیستم" (Register) with user icon
      - "ساخت حرفه ای پروفایل" (Create profile) with building icon  
      - "مشاهده پیشنهادات" (View offers) with document icon
    - Icons are outlined style, orange color, ~24px size, with text beside them

**G. App Download Banner:**
- Warm gradient background: Light orange to peach (`#FFE4D6` to `#FFDAB9` or similar)
- Rounded corners (~20px radius) on the banner container
- Left side: Image of man using phone (cutout with curved edge matching banner shape)
- Right side: Headline "همراه با فرآیند خرید حرفه ای شوید!" + subtext + Orange CTA button
- Max-width container, centered
- Padding: ~40-50px internal
- Button: Same orange as primary, with arrow icon

**H. Trust/About Section (اینجا مستقیم خرید و فروش کنید...):**
- Light gray background
- Four-column text layout with headings and paragraphs
- Clean typography, generous line-height (~1.8)
- Text color: Dark gray (`#374151`)

**I. About Buskool Section (باسکول چیست؟):**
- White background
- Two-column:
  - **Right:** Long descriptive text paragraph, justified alignment, leading-relaxed
  - **Left:** Collage of circular profile photos of diverse people (team/users), overlapping arrangement, various sizes (large center circle ~150px, smaller ones ~80-100px around it), soft shadows on each photo

**J. Features Icon Bar:**
- White background, subtle top border
- Three equal columns with centered content:
  - Icon (orange, ~40px size, filled style) + Title + optional subtitle
  - Features: "ارسال پیام مستقیم و چت", "پشتیبانی آنلاین و تلفنی", "ارسال محتوای تبلیغاتی"

**K. Footer:**
- White background with top border (`#E5E7EB`)
- **Top row:** Social media icons (Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, Telegram) - gray, ~20px size, hover effect likely
- **Main grid:** 5 columns
  - Column 1: Logo + description text (light gray) + trust badges/certification logos at bottom (row of small images)
  - Columns 2-5: Link lists with gray headings and lighter gray links
- **Bottom bar:** Copyright text, legal links, very light gray text (`#9CA3AF`)
- Padding: ~60-80px vertical

## 3. Typography Style

**Font Family:** Likely **IranSans**, **Vazir**, or **Shabnam** (standard Persian web fonts) - clean sans-serif with good readability

**Hierarchy:**
- **H1 (Hero):** ~32-36px, Bold (700), White
- **H2 (Section Titles):** ~24-28px, Bold (700), Dark (`#111827`), centered
- **H3 (Card Titles):** ~14-16px, Semi-bold (600), Dark gray
- **Body Text:** ~14px, Regular (400), Gray (`#4B5563`), line-height 1.6-1.8
- **Small/Caption:** ~12px, Regular, Light gray (`#6B7280`)
- **Button Text:** ~14-16px, Bold (600-700), White on orange

**Direction:** RTL (Right-to-Left) throughout

## 4. Hero Section Design Details

- **Background:** High-quality warehouse/logistics photography with cardboard boxes, worker in safety vest
- **Overlay:** Gradient from right (darker) to left (lighter) or uniform dark overlay `linear-gradient(to left, rgba(0,0,0,0.7), rgba(0,0,0,0.3))`
- **Text Alignment:** Right-aligned (RTL)
- **Headline:** "باسکول | بازار تجارت و فروش عمده محصولات" - Large, bold, white, possibly with text-shadow for readability
- **Subheadline:** Smaller, ~16-18px, opacity ~0.9 white
- **CTA Button:** 
  - Background: `#FF9F2A`
  - Text: "ثبت نام رایگان" (Free Registration)
  - Padding: ~12px 32px
  - Border-radius: ~8px
  - Shadow: `0 4px 12px rgba(255, 159, 42, 0.3)`
  - Hover state likely darker orange

## 5. Category Cards Design

**Container:**
- Width: ~140-180px
- Display: Flex, column, center-aligned
- No card background (transparent) - just image + text

**Image Circle:**
- Shape: Perfect circle (`border-radius: 50%`)
- Size: ~110-130px diameter
- Background: Varies by category (soft pastels: `#FEF3C7` for grains, `#FCE7F3` for clothes, `#DBEAFE` for machinery, etc.)
- Border: None or very subtle `1px solid #F3F4F6`
- Shadow: Soft drop shadow `0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)`
- Content: Product photo centered, slightly padded, realistic product images with transparent or matched backgrounds
- Hover effect: Likely scale up (1.05) or shadow increase

**Text Label:**
- Margin-top: ~12-16px
- Font-size: ~13-14px
- Font-weight: 500 (Medium)
- Color: `#374151`
- Text-align: Center
- Max-lines: 1 or 2 (with ellipsis if overflow)

**Categories visible:** Clothing/Shoes, Jackets, Wire/Cable, Construction materials, Grains/Agriculture, Sports equipment, Electronics/Audio, Personal care, Food/Beverage, Heavy machinery

## 6. Buy Request Form Design

**Form Container:**
- Background: White
- Border-radius: ~16px (quite rounded)
- Box-shadow: `0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)` (diffused, soft)
- Padding: ~32-40px
- Width: ~100% of column (likely 55-60% of container width)

**Form Fields:**
- **Labels:** Above input, ~13-14px, medium weight, dark gray (`#374151`), required fields have red asterisk
- **Input Boxes:**
  - Height: ~44-48px
  - Border: `1px solid #D1D5DB` (light gray)
  - Border-radius: ~8px
  - Padding: ~12px 16px
  - Font-size: ~14px
  - Focus state: Orange border (`#FF9F2A`) with ring shadow
  - Placeholder text: Light gray (`#9CA3AF`)
- **Special Elements:**
  - Category dropdown: Has down chevron, selected value shows in black/dark, hint text "مثلا: پوشاک و پارچه" in lighter gray
  - Quantity row: Two inputs side-by-side with labels "حداقل" (min) and "حداکثر" (max), gap between them ~12px
  - Textarea: Height ~100-120px, resize: none or vertical only

**Submit Button:**
- Background: `#FF9F2A` (same orange)
- Color: White
- Font-weight: 600
- Border-radius: ~8px
- Width: 100%
- Height: ~48px
- Margin-top: ~24px
- Transition: background-color 0.2s ease

**Info Panel (Left Side):**
- Background: Transparent (inherits section gray)
- Padding-left: ~40px (in RTL context)
- **Heading:** ~20-22px, bold, dark
- **Paragraph:** ~14px, gray, line-height 1.7, margin-bottom ~24px
- **Feature List:**
  - Each item: Flex row (icon + text)
  - Icon: ~24x24px, orange (`#F97316` or `#FF9F2A`), outline/stroke style
  - Text: ~14-15px, dark gray, font-weight 500
  - Spacing between items: ~20px
  - Icon container: Sometimes has light orange background circle (~40px diameter, `#FFF7ED`)

## 7. Footer Design

**Structure:**
- Background: White (`#FFFFFF`)
- Border-top: `1px solid #E5E7EB`
- Container max-width: ~1200-1280px, centered
- Padding: ~60px top, ~30px bottom

**Social Row:**
- Justified left (in RTL = actually aligned to start of reading direction)
- Icons: 20px size, `#6B7280` (medium gray)
- Hover: `#FF9F2A` (brand orange) or darken
- Gap between icons: ~16-20px
- Platforms: Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, Telegram

**Link Columns (4 columns + 1 brand column):**

*Column 1 (Brand):*
- Logo: buskool (larger size)
- Description: ~13px, `#6B7280`, line-height 1.8, max-width ~280px, margin-bottom ~24px
- Trust Badges: Row of 4-5 small certification/logo images (e-namad, Samandehi, etc.), grayscale or subtle color, ~40px height each, gap ~12px

*Columns 2-5 (Navigation):*
- **Headings:** ~15px, bold, `#111827`, margin-bottom ~16px
- **Links:** 
  - List style: None
  - Font-size: ~13-14px
  - Color: `#6B7280`
  - Line-height: ~2.2 (generous spacing)
  - Hover: `#FF9F2A` or `#111827`
  - Text-decoration: None (underline on hover)
- **Column titles example:** "دسته بندی", "خدمات", "حساب کاربری", "باسکول"

**Bottom Bar:**
- Border-top: `1px solid #F3F4F6` (very light)
- Padding-top: ~24px
- Flex layout: Space between
- **Copyright:** ~12px, `#9CA3AF` (light gray)
- **Legal Links:** "قوانین و مقررات", "حریم خصوصی" etc., same size, separated by `|` or spacing

**Spacing Details:**
- Gap between footer columns: ~40-60px
- Overall padding-x: ~24px (mobile) to ~40px (desktop)

**Visual Polish:**
- No heavy shadows in footer (flat design)
- Clean, minimal, information-dense but breathable
- Typography hierarchy maintained with color rather than just size

---

**General UI Patterns:**
- **Border Radius:** Consistently 8px for buttons/inputs, 12-16px for cards, 50% for avatars/category images, 20px+ for large banners
- **Shadows:** Very subtle throughout - `0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)` for cards, slightly stronger for form containers
- **Spacing System:** Appears to use 4px or 8px base unit (multiples of 8: 16, 24, 32, 48, 64px)
- **RTL Considerations:** All padding/margins flipped, icons positioned correctly for right-to-left reading, form labels above inputs (universal), text alignment natural to Persian
